LanguageData.RW_Upgrader_AutoUpgradeDesc: When enabled, a free construction-skilled colonist will automatically be assigned to upgrade this item's quality when materials are available.
LanguageData.RW_Upgrader_UpgradeNoChange: {0} upgrade attempt finished with no quality improvement.
LanguageData.RW_Upgrader_Setting_AutoEnableDesc: Newly built buildings will have "Auto-upgrade" switched on automatically. Existing buildings aren't affected retroactively.
LanguageData.RW_Upgrader_Setting_IncreasePerTierDesc: Each successive upgrade tier costs more resources: base cost x (tier number). E.g. a 5% base cost means Awful->Poor costs 5%, Poor->Normal costs 10%, and so on.
LanguageData.RW_Upgrader_AutoUpgradeMaterialDesc: When enabled, a free construction-skilled colonist will automatically be assigned to rebuild this item in a better material when one is available and allowed.
